platform: # SRA QC-comparison download set (separate, driven by download_pacbio.slurm.sh, not the analysis subset above):
# Chosen by file-size quartile spread (a complexity/read-depth proxy, not a
# subtype proxy -- all 24/9 raw files are already downloaded, so this costs
# zero new downloads). If per-sample subtype labels are available from the
# source publications (PRJNA207834, PRJNA765218), it's worth a manual check
# that these 7 samples span A1/D/recombinant diversity before relying on
# them for the assembly/MSA/subtyping comparisons -- not something derivable
# from the raw read data alone.
# PacBio (HIV-SMRTcap, PRJNA1251704 + PRJNA1252688): unlike the two Illumina/
# Nanopore projects, these are NOT pre-downloaded -- scripts/download_qc/
# pacbio/download_pacbio.slurm.sh fetches exactly the accessions listed above.
# Subtype is NOT in the SRA metadata, so "A1/D/recombinants only" is applied
# by cohort membership, not a metadata field: the RAKAIUG_donor* runs are the
# Rakai Uganda cohort (the A1/D/recombinant target population per Lee et al.
# 2024, Nat Commun 15:5513), and are the actual analysis samples; their exact
# subtype is what the subtyping step determines. 92UG_029 (subtype A/A1) and
# 93UG_065 (subtype D) are LANL Ugandan reference isolates included as
# known-subtype anchors/positive controls. Deliberately EXCLUDED as non-A1/D
# controls: 89BZ_167 (B), 93MW_965 (C), 8e5* / 10011_BR / MHBB676HT / PDX /
# HOPE cell-line and control libraries. The three ~18GB Revio Rakai runs
# (SRR33251361/56/52) are omitted from this cheap tier to keep the subset
# download/runtime modest; add them for a scale-stress test once tool choices
# are settled.
